snippets.title: Type-checking JVM stacks across branches
snippets.caption: Part of a JVM bytecode generator built for MSU's compilers course: on every jump, the builder either seeds the target block with the current operand-stack types or checks they match what's already expected there.

snippets.title: Opaque handles for a C API
snippets.caption: Part of Styx's C bindings: one macro line per type generates a C-visible marker struct `Foo_t` and a `#[repr(transparent)]` handle around a typed opaque pointer, so C code holds safe, typed handles to Rust objects.

snippets.title: Operators inferred from the shape of a type
snippets.caption: The derive macro reads each enum variant's fields and decides whether it is a binary, prefix or postfix operator, so a precedence-climbing parser is generated from type definitions alone.

snippets.title: Brace-balanced f-string expressions
snippets.caption: Inside an f-string, the tokenizer tracks nested `{`/`}` depth to cut out exactly one embedded expression, which is then handed to the full Notch parser.

snippets.title: Parsing calls with error recovery
snippets.caption: From Sea, a simplified C for teaching systems programming: the call-argument loop doesn't stop at the first bad token, it turns it into an error node and keeps parsing.

snippets.title: Racing tasks to a graceful shutdown
snippets.caption: From a grading server for MSU's security course: the first task to finish trips a shared shutdown flag, and the rest get 10 seconds to drain before the process exits.

snippets.title: Any closure is a parser primitive
snippets.caption: A blanket impl over `FnOnce(char) -> bool` means `parser.take(char::is_whitespace)` works right alongside the `char`, `&str` and `[char; N]` impls.

snippets.title: Python hooks from an X-macro
snippets.caption: Styx's Python bindings list every emulator hook once in an X-macro; `define_hooks!` turns each entry into a pyo3 class that wraps a Python callback and bridges it to the Rust hook trait.

snippets.title: Pinch-zoom that stops softly
snippets.caption: When a pinch on the periodic table goes past the zoom limits, the zoom-centring offset is scaled back by the same fraction, so it stops at the limit instead of jumping.

snippets.title: A tiny DSL for running commands
snippets.caption: `cmd!` takes an optional `in dir;`, variadic args and an inline configuration hook, and fails at compile time with a clear message when called empty.

snippets.title: Catching edited autograder releases
snippets.caption: Autograder results are published as GitHub releases. If a student edits one, this action snapshots the edit event as an artifact and opens an issue for the instructor.
snippets.code:
steps:
  - run: |
      cp $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH release
  - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
    id: upload-release-diff
    with:
      name: Release Diff
      path: release
      if-no-files-found: error
      retention-days: 90
      overwrite: false
  - uses: actions/checkout@v3
  - uses: JasonEtco/create-an-issue@v2
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      ARTIFACT_URL: ${{ steps.upload-release-diff.outputs.artifact-url }}
    with:
      filename: .github/ANTICHEAT_TEMPLATE.md

snippets.title: One fold for every precedence level
snippets.caption: A generic left fold turns a flat list like `a * b / c` into a left-associative syntax tree, so each binary-operator level of the parser is a one-liner.

snippets.title: Sudoku as wave function collapse
snippets.caption: Sudoku expressed as rules for a generic wave-function-collapse solver: a cell may hold whatever its row, column and 3×3 block leave over.

snippets.title: An if / else-if chain from a quote! repetition
snippets.caption: Using `else` as the repetition separator turns a list of variant parsers into one `if let … else if let … else` chain, with a type-named error as the fallback.

snippets.title: Route matching with captured variables
snippets.caption: The core of a Dart router: matches a path segment by segment, checks optional per-segment regex constraints, and captures path variables as it goes.
